knownRisks.mitigation: Add a periodic cleanup job (delete rows where cooldown_until < now() - 30 days). Team 24 or Team 6 (scheduler) can add this as a cron rule.

knownRisks.risk: Funnel event type strings are not validated at insert time
knownRisks.mitigation: cc_funnel_snapshots CASE expression will simply ignore unknown event types — silently returns zero for unknown stages. Not a correctness risk, just visibility.

knownRisks.risk: Attribution touchpoints are inferred from UTM params, which can be spoofed
knownRisks.mitigation: Attribution is a READ MODEL only — no financial decisions are made solely based on it. It is advisory for marketing analysis.

knownRisks.risk: Bundle price is a recommendation, not enforced in the payment system
knownRisks.mitigation: bundle.requiresApproval=true for >20% discount. Approval triggers commercial.approval.granted event; downstream payment/quotation system applies the actual discount.

knownRisks.risk: COOLDOWN_HOURS values are hardcoded in types.ts
knownRisks.mitigation: Move to ai_settings table for operator configurability in a follow-up. Not required for MVP.
